C# — Internal participation in deformation LUT

Correspond EpicEye.Intrinsics.cs and `EpicEye.Intrinsics.Lut.cs`contains online reading/Writing and Offline LUT Calculating.

API Reference

GetCameraMatrix / GetCameraMatrixAsync

Purpose: Reads the current deep camera needle inner cucumber matrix.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

string

Camera address.

timeout

int

Request timeout in milliseconds; Default: 2000.

Returns: ApiResponse<double[>]; 9 Bank Priority [fx,0,cx,0,fy,cy,0,0,1].

GetDistortion / GetDistortionAsync

Purpose: Read Brown-Conrady Aberration. The result of the binary calibration is zero.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

string

Camera address.

timeout

int

Request timeout in milliseconds; Default: 2000.

Returns: ApiResponse<double[]>;orders [k1,k2,p1,p2,k3].

GetCameraParameters / GetCameraParametersAsync

Purpose: Reads the complete internal and external input that the camera currently saves.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

string

Camera address.

timeout

int

Request timeout in milliseconds; Default: 5000.

Returns: ApiResponse<JsonElement>; field pools are determined by the camera reconstructioner and the image source.

GetUndistortLut / GetUndistortLutAsync

Purpose: Fetching deformity search tables online and cacheing.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

string

Camera address.

depthWidth

int

Value of depthWidth; Default: 0.

depthHeight

int

Value of depthHeight; Default: 0.

cameraMatrix

double[]?

Row-major 3×3 camera intrinsic matrix; Default: null.

distortion

double[]?

Brown-Conrady distortion coefficients; Default: null.

timeout

int

Request timeout in milliseconds; synchronous default: 15000; asynchronous default: 5000.

Returns: byte[]?, width×height×2 Line Priority float32 (u,v);total Zero malformation or failure as null.

ComputeUndistortLut

Purpose: Compute pure locally LUT, does not connect the camera, does not write the cache.

Parameters

Name Type Description

width

int

Image width in pixels.

height

int

Image height in pixels.

cameraMatrix

double[]

Row-major 3×3 camera intrinsic matrix.

distortion

double[]

Brown-Conrady distortion coefficients.

Returns: Idem; invalid or aberrant at full zero null.

ClearUndistortedLUTCache(ip=null)

Purpose: Clear specified camera or all LUT Cache.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

string?

Camera address; Default: null.

Returns: None.

SetCameraIntrinsicParameters / SetCameraIntrinsicParametersAsync

Purpose: Writes and applies the full internal and external participatory configuration.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

string

Camera address.

cameraParametersConfig

CameraParametersConfig

Complete intrinsic and extrinsic configuration.

timeout

int

Request timeout in milliseconds; Default: 2000.

Returns: ApiResponse<bool>; Data=true It means you’re successful. ErrorMessage.

RestoreFactoryIntrinsic / RestoreFactoryIntrinsicAsync

Purpose: Resumes the camera to enter the plant. The operation replaces the current calibration.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

string

Camera address.

timeout

int

Request timeout in milliseconds; Default: 2000.

Returns: ApiResponse<bool>; Data=true That means we’re going to make it. We’re going to make it. ErrorMessage. == Example: Read and calculate LUT

var matrix = await EpicEye.GetCameraMatrixAsync(ip);
var distortion = await EpicEye.GetDistortionAsync(ip);
if (matrix.Status != 0 || distortion.Status != 0 ||
    matrix.Data is null || distortion.Data is null)
{
    return;
}

int width = 2048;
int height = 1536;
byte[]? lut = EpicEye.ComputeUndistortLut(width, height, matrix.Data, distortion.Data);

if (lut is null && distortion.Data.All(value => Math.Abs(value) < 1e-8))
{
    Console.WriteLine("It's not necessary to turn it into zero. LUT");
}

Example: Read the full camera internal and external reference

var response = await EpicEye.GetCameraParametersAsync(ip);
if (response.Status != 0)
{
    throw new InvalidOperationException(response.ErrorMessage);
}

Console.WriteLine(JsonSerializer.Serialize(response.Data, new JsonSerializerOptions
{
    WriteIndented = true
}));
